name: m7-local-model-routing
title: M7 Local Model Routing And Benchmark
description: Add provider routing, fallback and circuit-breaker contracts plus reproducible model/embedding benchmark metadata without fabricating GPU or vLLM results.
scope: provider route descriptors; timeout/rate-limit/server-error fallback; circuit breaker; health probes; embedding dimension isolation; benchmark schema and reports
creator: developer
notes: M7 local routing and immutable reviewed evidence remain valid. Release v0.1.31 records primary glm-5-2 execution plus a validated DeepSeek-V4-Flash fallback route with provider request count, tokens, fallback trigger metadata, breaker state, and stable release metadata. Real-provider repeatability remains open because the post-v0.1.30 follow-ups include one control-plane abort and two distinct single-case system failures; prepare targeted remediation, stable observed route identity, provider revision/cost inputs, and representative-corpus review before another full 40-case run. M7-R7 GPU/vLLM/quantization capacity is explicitly excluded and must not be reported as passed or blocked work for this release.
